protocol.stage: Prospective confirmation; sealed before new target outcomes

premeasurement_restart.reason: The first measurement attempt exposed a missing scenario-index mapping in the journal writer. No complete response bank, non-empty journal, cost record or selector result was persisted. All initially allocated coordinates were quarantined because the process pool may already have executed work; the corrected confirmation uses disjoint scenario seeds.

candidate.prior: Uniform normalized physical behavior coordinates; balanced controller type
candidate.selection: Posterior mean collision probability after integrating the local risk-residual GP posterior
candidate.online_feedback: One queried continuous risk per selector step; collision labels remain hidden except to RAS
candidate.collision_only_ablation: Separate collision-logit-only logistic decoder fit to the same 48 development profiles

protocol.statistical_unit: SUT profile; average both pools and all five predictor seeds
protocol.zero_failure_pool: Area=0; recall=1; retained with zero paired difference
protocol.testing: Eight exact two-sided paired sign-flip tests with Holm correction
protocol.confidence_interval: Paired bootstrap within controller kind, 20000 draws
protocol.success_rule: Both co-primary metrics must be positive with Holm p below round alpha against all four primary controls; both bootstrap 95% lower limits must be positive against previous_best and matched_collision_gp
protocol.multiple_rounds: Spend 0.05/2**r; any failed round becomes development and requires new profiles and coordinates
protocol.target_parameters: Retained by measurement parent and never sent to selectors
protocol.full_target_arrays: Retained by measurement parent; each isolated selector receives one allowed response at a time
protocol.scope: New IDM/FVDM parameter profiles in declared ranges, same simulator and two finite scenario families
